verses.ar: مَوَازِينُ غِشٍّ مَكْرَهَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَٱلْوَزْنُ ٱلصَّحِيحُ رِضَاهُ.
verses.kjv: A false balance [is] abomination to the LORD: but a just weight [is] his delight.
verses.web: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
verses.he: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תֹּועֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצֹונֹֽו׃

verses.ar: تَأْتِي ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءُ فَيَأْتِي ٱلْهَوَانُ، وَمَعَ ٱلْمُتَوَاضِعِينَ حِكْمَةٌ.
verses.kjv: [When] pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly [is] wisdom.
verses.web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.he: בָּֽא־זָ֭דֹון וַיָּבֹ֣א קָלֹ֑ון וְֽאֶת־צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה׃

verses.ar: اِسْتِقَامَةُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ تَهْدِيهِمْ، وَٱعْوِجَاجُ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ يُخْرِبُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.he: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בֹּוגְדִ֣ים *וְשַׁדָּם (יְשָׁדֵּֽם)׃

verses.ar: لَا يَنْفَعُ ٱلْغِنَى فِي يَوْمِ ٱلسَّخَطِ، أَمَّا ٱلْبِرُّ فَيُنَجِّي مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.he: לֹא־יֹועִ֣יל הֹ֭ון בְּיֹ֣ום עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃

verses.ar: بِرُّ ٱلْكَامِلِ يُقَوِّمُ طَرِيقَهُ، أَمَّا ٱلشِّرِّيرُ فَيَسْقُطُ بِشَرِّهِ.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.web: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.he: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכֹּ֑ו וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָתֹ֗ו יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃

verses.ar: بِرُّ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ يُنَجِّيهِمْ، أَمَّا ٱلْغَادِرُونَ فَيُؤْخَذُونَ بِفَسَادِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in [their own] naughtiness.
verses.web: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
verses.he: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَ مَوْتِ إِنْسَانٍ شِرِّيرٍ يَهْلِكُ رَجَاؤُهُ، وَمُنْتَظَرُ ٱلْأَثَمَةِ يَبِيدُ.
verses.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust [men] perisheth.
verses.web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
verses.he: בְּמֹ֤ות אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתֹוחֶ֖לֶת אֹונִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃

verses.ar: اَلصِّدِّيقُ يَنْجُو مِنَ ٱلضِّيقِ، وَيَأْتِي ٱلشِّرِّيرُ مَكَانَهُ.
verses.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.web: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
verses.he: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

verses.ar: بِٱلْفَمِ يُخْرِبُ ٱلْمُنَافِقُ صَاحِبَهُ، وَبِالْمَعْرِفَةِ يَنْجُو ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ.
verses.kjv: An hypocrite with [his] mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
verses.he: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃

verses.ar: بِخَيْرِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ تَفْرَحُ ٱلْمَدِينَةُ، وَعِنْدَ هَلَاكِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ هُتَافٌ.
verses.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, [there is] shouting.
verses.web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.he: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃

verses.ar: بِبَرَكَةِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ تَعْلُو ٱلْمَدِينَةُ، وَبِفَمِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ تُهْدَمُ.
verses.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.he: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃

verses.ar: اَلْمُحْتَقِرُ صَاحِبَهُ هُوَ نَاقِصُ ٱلْفَهْمِ، أَمَّا ذُو ٱلْفَهْمِ فَيَسْكُتُ.
verses.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.he: בָּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנֹ֣ות יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃

verses.ar: ٱلسَّاعِي بِٱلْوِشَايَةِ يُفْشِي ٱلسِّرَّ، وَٱلْأَمِينُ ٱلرُّوحِ يَكْتُمُ ٱلْأَمْرَ.
verses.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
verses.he: הֹולֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־סֹּ֑וד וְנֶאֱמַן־ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃

verses.ar: حَيْثُ لَا تَدْبِيرٌ يَسْقُطُ ٱلشَّعْبُ، أَمَّا ٱلْخَلَاصُ فَبِكَثْرَةِ ٱلْمُشِيرِينَ.
verses.kjv: Where no counsel [is], the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors [there is] safety.
verses.web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
verses.he: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלֹות יִפָּל־עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יֹועֵֽץ׃

verses.ar: ضَرَرًا يُضَرُّ مَنْ يَضْمَنُ غَرِيبًا، وَمَنْ يُبْغِضُ صَفْقَ ٱلْأَيْدِي مُطْمَئِنٌّ.
verses.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart [for it:] and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
verses.he: רַע־יֵ֭רֹועַ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בֹּוטֵֽחַ׃

verses.ar: اَلْمَرْأَةُ ذَاتُ ٱلنِّعْمَةِ تُحَصِّلُ كَرَامَةً، وَٱلْأَشِدَّاءُ يُحَصِّلُونَ غِنًى.
verses.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong [men] retain riches.
verses.web: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
verses.he: אֵֽשֶׁת־חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּבֹ֑וד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹֽשֶׁר׃

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ يُحْسِنُ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَٱلْقَاسِي يُكَدِّرُ لَحْمَهُ.
verses.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but [he that is] cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.he: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשֹׁו אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵרֹ֗ו אַכְזָרִֽי׃

verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ يَكْسَبُ أُجْرَةَ غِشٍّ، وَٱلزَّارِعُ ٱلْبِرَّ أُجْرَةَ أَمَانَةٍ.
verses.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness [shall be] a sure reward.
verses.web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.he: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃

verses.ar: كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ يَؤُولُ إِلَى ٱلْحَيَاةِ كَذَلِكَ مَنْ يَتْبَعُ ٱلشَّرَّ فَإِلَى مَوْتِهِ.
verses.kjv: As righteousness [tendeth] to life: so he that pursueth evil [pursueth it] to his own death.
verses.web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
verses.he: כֵּן־צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמֹותֹֽו׃

verses.ar: كَرَاهَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ مُلْتَوُو ٱلْقَلْبِ، وَرِضَاهُ مُسْتَقِيمُو ٱلطَّرِيقِ.
verses.kjv: They that are of a froward heart [are] abomination to the LORD: but [such as are] upright in [their] way [are] his delight.
verses.web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
verses.he: תֹּועֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצֹונֹ֗ו תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃

verses.ar: يَدٌ لِيَدٍ لَا يَتَبَرَّرُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ، أَمَّا نَسْلُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ فَيَنْجُو.
verses.kjv: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.he: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃

verses.ar: خِزَامَةُ ذَهَبٍ فِي فِنْطِيسَةِ خِنْزِيرَةٍ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْجَمِيلَةُ ٱلْعَدِيمَةُ ٱلْعَقْلِ.
verses.kjv: [As] a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, [so is] a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.web: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.he: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃

verses.ar: شَهْوَةُ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ خَيْرٌ فَقَطْ. رَجَاءُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ سَخَطٌ.
verses.kjv: The desire of the righteous [is] only good: [but] the expectation of the wicked [is] wrath.
verses.web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־טֹ֑וב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃

verses.ar: يُوجَدُ مَنْ يُفَرِّقُ فَيَزْدَادُ أَيْضًا، وَمَنْ يُمْسِكُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱللَّائِقِ وَإِنَّمَا إِلَى ٱلْفَقْرِ.
verses.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and [there is] that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] to poverty.
verses.web: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
verses.he: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנֹוסָ֥ף עֹ֑וד וְחֹושֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֹֽור׃

verses.ar: ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلسَّخِيَّةُ تُسَمَّنُ، وَٱلْمُرْوِي هُوَ أَيْضًا يُرْوَى.
verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verses.he: נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ה֥וּא יֹורֶֽא׃

verses.ar: مُحْتَكِرُ ٱلْحِنْطَةِ يَلْعَنُهُ ٱلشَّعْبُ، وَٱلْبَرَكَةُ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْبَائِعِ.
verses.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing [shall be] upon the head of him that selleth [it].
verses.web: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.he: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְאֹ֑ום וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃

verses.ar: مَنْ يَطْلُبُ ٱلْخَيْرَ يَلْتَمِسُ ٱلرِّضَا، وَمَنْ يَطْلُبُ ٱلشَّرَّ فَٱلشَّرُّ يَأْتِيهِ.
verses.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
verses.he: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר טֹ֭וב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצֹ֑ון וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבֹואֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: مَنْ يَتَّكِلْ عَلَى غِنَاهُ يَسْقُطْ، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ فَيَزْهُونَ كَٱلْوَرَقِ.
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.he: בֹּוטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרֹו ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃

verses.ar: مَنْ يُكَدِّرُ بَيْتَهُ يَرِثِ ٱلرِّيحَ، وَٱلْغَبِيُّ خَادِمٌ لِحَكِيمِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool [shall be] servant to the wise of heart.
verses.web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.he: עֹוכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתֹו יִנְחַל־ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם־לֵֽב׃

verses.ar: ثَمَرُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ شَجَرَةُ حَيَاةٍ، وَرَابِحُ ٱلنُّفُوسِ حَكِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: The fruit of the righteous [is] a tree of life; and he that winneth souls [is] wise.
verses.web: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
verses.he: פְּֽרִי־צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשֹׂ֣ות חָכָֽם׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ يُجَازَى فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ، فَكَمْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ وَٱلْخَاطِئُ!
verses.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.he: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־רָשָׁ֥ע וְחֹוטֵֽא׃
